title: Close the raise and return excess funds
summary: End the offering, return anything not accepted, and update the investor register and filings.
outlineSteps: Fix the offering's closing date from the offering documents
Reconcile the investor register to the bank and resolve every difference
List the money to return for subscriptions declined or cut back
Verify any request to send a refund elsewhere by phone at a known number
Have a person approve and return each amount as the offering documents provide, to the account it came from
Confirm each refund left the account and reached the investor
Confirm the register and bank agree after refunds
Send each investor confirmation of the final amount accepted
Ask counsel which federal and state notices change now the offering has closed
File the closing record and keep it
